restaurant_name: คลินิก สมยศ ทันตแพทย์
text: Who would have thought? This clinic only has one doctor. The doctor is knowledgeable and experienced, but their work is focused on their own convenience, constantly rescheduling patients' appointments without regard for date or time. The concept here is "the doctor won't extract" teeth; you'll have to ask the doctor for the reason. The dental assistants are all lovely, but the counter service is terrible. They constantly have to call to reschedule appointments, and they never issue receipts. I've been receiving treatment here for a year and still haven't received a receipt. I'm personally very frustrated. I've also received numerous complaints about the appointment delays. I switched clinics and started treatment anew; the doctor didn't reschedule, and everything was resolved very quickly. I was able to focus on my life and no longer have to deal with the constant delays at this clinic.
